item.title: An Iowa House committee may soon consider requiring that ALL occupants in a vehicle wear a seat belt
item.description: Current Iowa law says children under 12, drivers and front seat occupants of vehicles must be belted in, but an Iowa House committee may soon consider requiring that ALL occupants in a vehicle wear a seat belt.
